title: Procurement intake split-test: conditional pricing, SOC2-lite option, & insurance offset path
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Background:
Redwood's vendor onboarding is a major friction point for enterprise contracts. Sales reports indicate a 26% dropoff between initial SSO submission and final contract for medium-sized customers when onboarding requires a full SOC2 package and brokered insurance. We need an experiment to reduce dropoff while preserving risk posture and legal compliance.

Objective:
Run a controlled split-test across production procurement intake to evaluate tradeoffs between speed-to-contract and residual risk/cost. Outcome will inform a modular onboarding offering: self-serve SOC2-lite + insurance-offset credits vs traditional full-evidence path.

Hypothesis:
1) Adding a conditional, dynamic intake that surfaces a "SOC2-lite + insurance offset" fast-track will increase completed onboarding conversions by >12% for customers with < $5M ARR and standard security appetites.
2) A short intake (6 fields) + automated risk score + 48-hour legal review reduces time-to-contract by at least 40% without materially increasing downstream incidents.

Experiment arms (randomized at account-level):
- Arm A (Control): Current long-form intake + full SOC2 evidence requirement + manual underwriting.
- Arm B (Short form + Automated Triage): 6-field intake, automated triage (risk score), auto-accept for low/medium scores, manual review queue for medium/high. Pricing unchanged.
- Arm C (Fast-track SOC2-lite + Insurance Offset): Short form plus offer to purchase an insurance credit bundle (partnered broker) or apply for SOC2-lite (attestation + continuous monitoring agent). If chosen, legal fast-track and 10% pricing credit applied at contract signature.

Metrics (primary/secondary):
- Primary: onboarding completion rate (signed contract / started intake) over 30 days; time-to-contract median; volume of onboarded accounts per week.
- Secondary: fraction escalated to manual review, number of post-onboarding security findings in first 90 days, revenue-weighted onboarding success, legal exceptions created, cost of insurance credits issued.

Telemetry / tracking plan:
Emit events: procurement.intake.started, procurement.intake.submitted, procurement.intake.arm_assigned, procurement.risk_score, procurement.insurance_selected, procurement.triage.outcome, procurement.contract.signed. Add tags for ARR bucket, vertical, and account tier. Capture utm_campaign for GTM attribution.

Success criteria:
- A/B winner must show >=12% relative uplift in completion rate and <=10% increase in early security findings compared to control OR time-to-contract reduction >=40% with comparable risk profile.

Operational considerations:
- Legal/Compliance: any SOC2-lite pathway must include contractual language (template in Legal folder) and auditability hooks. Legal review required prior to enabling Arm C.
- Partnerships: partner broker contract required to offer insurance credits. Procurement to confirm API and settlement flow.
- Billing: Finance must support credit issuance flow and one-off refund logic.
- Support: CS playbook for customers who choose SOC2-lite must be created.

Rollout plan:
- Week 0: finalize PRD & legal templates (this ticket).
- Week 1: Instrumentation & short-form UI (DES/ENG tasks).
- Week 2: Partner integration (insurance broker sandbox), automated triage model tuning.
- Week 3: Canary to 10% of new procurement flows, monitor metrics daily.
- Week 4-6: Full experiment at 40% traffic, run 30 days. Analyze and recommend.

Risks & Mitigations:
- Risk: Insufficient data in 30 days. Mitigation: extend experiment to 60 days or prioritize higher-volume segments.
- Risk: Legal pushback on SOC2-lite. Mitigation: include strict monitoring and termination clauses, require agent-based telemetry.
- Risk: Insurance payout disputes. Mitigation: settle contract terms with broker and require broker SLAs.

Acceptance criteria:
- Instrumentation events emitting correctly and visible in analytics dashboard.
- Short intake UI approved by Design and implemented behind feature flag.
- Legal templates reviewed and signed off by Legal.
- Broker contract MOU in place and sandbox integration passing smoke tests.
- Experiment rollout checklist completed and stakeholders notified.

Deliverables:
- PRD (linked above), short-form intake design, canonical legal templates, instrumentation dashboard, experiment analysis report with recommendation.
acceptance_criteria: 1) All telemetry events documented and visible in GH analytics dashboard; 2) Short intake UX implemented and A/B assignment tested; 3) Legal sign-off for SOC2-lite language; 4) Broker sandbox integrated; 5) Launch checklist executed and rollouts gated by feature flag; 6) Post-experiment report with recommendation and cost analysis.
